g.text: Literal Pazy: sensitivity to frozen aerodynamic influences
Four selected conditions • 120 requested / 121 actual intervals • no interpolation or fitted curve
Eight new equilibria on 60/120 requested intervals; all eight mesh checks < 0.1% (largest 0.00702%).
Each native mesh uses its own retained gravity baseline; the archive uses its retained initial row, whose operating condition is unknown.
Frozen influences use jig geometry and zero α/β; the beam still deforms. Historical K/F is unknown. This is a sensitivity study, not experimental validation.
